edges.reason: The Owned constructor reads msg.sender to initialize the owner state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership body runs.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before changing ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with the requested amount.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom reads and debits allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier that compares msg.sender to owner.
owner is read inside the onlyOwner require check.
owner is read in the onlyOwner check and used as the token recipient.
acceptOwnership emits owner in OwnershipTransferred and overwrites the owner slot.
transferOwnership stores the supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires, then clears, the newOwner state variable.
balanceOf returns the value read from the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for from and to.
approve writes into the allowed nested mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
The constructor assigns the minted supply to _totalSupply and to the initial holder.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
safeAdd performs the guarded unsigned addition.
safeSub performs the guarded unsigned subtraction.
safeMul performs the guarded unsigned multiplication.
safeDiv performs the guarded unsigned division.
transfer subtracts tokens from the sender balance through safeSub.
transfer adds tokens to the recipient balance through safeAdd.
transferFrom subtracts from both the source balance and the caller allowance via safeSub.
transferFrom adds tokens to the recipient balance through safeAdd.
totalSupply computes an unprotected subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
approveAndCall performs an external call to the spender after the allowance state write.
The spender contract regains control through receiveApproval and can re-enter token functions.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an attacker-supplied token contract address.
The external token contract regains control during the transfer call.
acceptOwnership updates owner based only on the msg.sender == newOwner check, with no other guard.
Parameter a feeds the addition in safeAdd.
Parameter b feeds the addition in safeAdd.
Parameter a feeds the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter b feeds the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter a feeds the multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b feeds the multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter a feeds the division in safeDiv.
Parameter b feeds the division in safeDiv.
The supplied address is stored into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
to is credited in the balances mapping during transfer.
tokens is the amount passed to safeSub and safeAdd in transfer.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens is the allowance value written in approve.
from indexes balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
to is credited in the balances mapping during transferFrom.
tokens is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is approved and then used as the target of the external call.
tokens is written to the allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
data is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress becomes the external contract targeted by the ERC20 transfer call.
tokens is the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: a is only an input of the safeAdd arithmetic and has no independent state effect.
b is only an input of the safeAdd arithmetic and has no independent state effect.
a is only an input of the safeSub arithmetic and has no independent state effect.
b is only an input of the safeSub arithmetic and has no independent state effect.
a is only an input of the safeMul arithmetic and has no independent state effect.
b is only an input of the safeMul arithmetic and has no independent state effect.
a is only an input of the safeDiv arithmetic and has no independent state effect.
b is only an input of the safeDiv arithmetic and has no independent state effect.
_newOwner is written straight into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
tokenOwner is only used to index the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
to is only the recipient index of the balances mapping in transfer.
tokens only parameterizes the safeSub and safeAdd calls in transfer.
spender only indexes the allowed mapping written by approve.
tokens is only the allowance value stored by approve.
from only indexes the balances and allowed mappings inside transferFrom.
to is only the recipient index of the balances mapping in transferFrom.
tokens only parameterizes the safeSub and safeAdd calls in transferFrom.
tokenOwner only indexes the allowed mapping read by allowance.
spender only indexes the allowed mapping read by allowance.
spender is both the approved address and the target of the external call.
tokens only parameterizes the allowance write and the forwarded callback value.
data is opaque caller bytes forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress becomes the untrusted target of the external ERC20 call.
tokens is only the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
